source.depthSource: SRTM Plus, as described by Natural Earth

method: Clip Natural Earth nested depth polygons to 110–180°E and 180–230°E (the latter unwrapped from negative longitudes across the antimeridian), union per depth, simplify at 0.04 degree tolerance with topology preserved, round to five decimal places and omit disjoint polygons under 0.005 square degrees and holes under 0.05 square degrees at this regional map scale. Thresholds are deeper-than areas; draw in ascending order over the shallow-sea base color in bathymetry.css. This is generalized regional cartography, not local sounding or navigation data.
